old_gate_assessment.conclusion: No current force bookkeeping, stale-data or duplicate-armature/friction bug was demonstrated. The observed event is a finite native-optimizer stationarity residual, not by itself evidence of hardware overload, an uncommanded external force or task failure. The original declared guard FAIL is retained, not retroactively relabelled PASS.
